name: La Zarza (Spain)
description: Red field with a white diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of La Zarza (a bramble bush on yellow within a red bordure of crosses).
history: The flag was approved on the same date as the arms (Diario Oficial de Extremadura no. 59 of 1 August 1991) and is described as a square red flag with a white bend and the municipal arms in its colours over all at the centre.

features.role: band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
